cards.ex: I told him to stay inside, I didn't want him in harm's way during the storm.
cards.exUz: Men unga ichkarida qolishni aytdim, bo'ron paytida uning xavf ostida bo'lishini xohlamadim.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli vaziyatda, xavfga duchor bo'lgan holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: You're playing with fire if you keep skipping classes; you'll fail the exam.
cards.exUz: Agar darslarni o'tkazib yuborishda davom etsang, olov bilan o'ynayapsan; imtihondan yiqilasan.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki nojo'ya ish bilan shug'ullanish, oqibatlarni hisobga olmaslik.

cards.ex: I decided to take a gamble and invest all my savings in the new business.
cards.exUz: Men tavakkal qilib, barcha jamg'armalarimni yangi biznesga sarmoya qilishga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan natijasi noma'lum bo'lgan, xavfli harakatni amalga oshirish.

cards.ex: He's on thin ice with his boss after missing several deadlines.
cards.exUz: U bir nechta muddatni o'tkazib yuborganidan so'ng, xo'jayini bilan noqulay vaziyatda.
cards.uzDef: Noqulay yoki xavfli vaziyatda, muammoga yaqin bo'lish.

cards.ex: His strange behavior raised red flags for the investigators.
cards.exUz: Uning g'alati xatti-harakatlari tergovchilar uchun shubha uyg'otdi.
cards.uzDef: Ogohlantiruvchi signallarni berish, shubha yoki xavotirga sabab bo'lish.

cards.ex: Mixing alcohol and driving is a recipe for disaster.
cards.exUz: Alkogol ichib mashina haydash - bu halokat retsepti.
cards.uzDef: Natijasi yomon bo'lishi aniq bo'lgan vaziyat yoki harakat.

cards.ex: I dodged a bullet when I decided not to invest in that company; it went bankrupt.
cards.exUz: Men o'sha kompaniyaga sarmoya qilmaslikka qaror qilganimda omadim keldi; u bankrot bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon bir narsadan zo'rg'a qutulish, xavfdan saqlanib qolish.

cards.ex: Starting a business during a recession is risky business.
cards.exUz: Recessiya davrida biznes boshlash xavfli ish.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki noaniq oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan faoliyat.

cards.ex: He bit off more than he could chew when he volunteered for three projects at once.
cards.exUz: U birdaniga uchta loyihaga ko'ngilli bo'lganida, uddalay oladiganidan ortiqcha yuk oldi.
cards.term: bite off more than one can chew
cards.uzDef: Qobiliyatidan ortiqcha vazifani o'z zimmasiga olish, uddalay olmaslik.

cards.ex: He's skating on the edge with his constant late arrivals to work.
cards.exUz: U ishga doimiy kech kelishi bilan xavf yoqasida yuribdi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki noaniq vaziyatda bo'lish, muammoga yaqinlashish.

cards.ex: You're tempting fate by driving without a seatbelt.
cards.exUz: Xavfsizlik kamarini taqmasdan haydash orqali taqdirni sinayapsiz.
cards.uzDef: Omadni yoki taqdirni sinovdan o'tkazish, xavfli ish qilish.

cards.ex: The diplomat is walking a tightrope trying to negotiate peace.
cards.exUz: Diplomat tinchlik muzokaralarini olib borishga urinib, arqonda yuribdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin va nozik vaziyatda harakat qilish, xato qilishdan ehtiyot bo'lish.

cards.ex: You're pushing your luck driving that fast in this weather.
cards.exUz: Bu ob-havoda bunchalik tez haydash bilan omadingizni sinayapsiz.
cards.uzDef: Omadli vaziyatni davom ettirishga harakat qilish, lekin xavfga duch kelish.

cards.ex: Some important safety regulations fell through the cracks during the inspection.
cards.exUz: Tekshiruv davomida ba'zi muhim xavfsizlik qoidalari e'tibordan chetda qoldi.
cards.uzDef: E'tibordan chetda qolish, unutib yuborilish yoki e'tiborsiz qoldirilish.

cards.ex: The builder cut corners on the construction, and now the building is unsafe.
cards.exUz: Quruvchi qurilishda xarajatlarni kamaytirdi va hozir bino xavfli.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni kamaytirish uchun sifat yoki xavfsizlikni qurbon qilish.

cards.ex: I'd hazard a guess that he's lying about his age.
cards.exUz: Men uning yoshi haqida yolg'on gapirayotganini taxmin qilardim.
cards.uzDef: Taxminiy javob berish, aniq bo'lmagan ma'lumotga asoslanib fikr bildirish.

cards.ex: That was a close call! A car almost hit me when I was crossing the street.
cards.exUz: Bu juda xavfli vaziyat edi! Ko'chani kesib o'tayotganimda mashina meni urib ketayozdi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli vaziyatdan zo'rg'a qutulish, halokatga yaqin kelish.

cards.ex: We shouldn't venture out into the woods at night.
cards.exUz: Biz kechasi o'rmonga chiqmasligimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki noma'lum joyga chiqish, sarguzashtga kirishish.

cards.ex: They're courting disaster by ignoring the safety warnings.
cards.exUz: Ular xavfsizlik ogohlantirishlariga e'tibor bermay, falokatni chaqirmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: O'zini xavfli vaziyatga qo'yish, falokatga sabab bo'ladigan ish qilish.

cards.ex: The patient is still in the hospital, but he's out of the woods now.
cards.exUz: Bemor hali ham kasalxonada, lekin u hozir xavfdan xalos bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki xavfli vaziyatdan qutulish, muammolarni ortda qoldirish.

cards.ex: His career is on the line if he makes another mistake.
cards.exUz: Agar u yana xato qilsa, uning faoliyati xavf ostida.
cards.uzDef: Xavf ostida bo'lish, yo'qotish yoki zarar ko'rish ehtimoli mavjud bo'lish.

cards.ex: Allowing children to watch too much TV can be a slippery slope to addiction.
cards.exUz: Bolalarga juda ko'p televizor ko'rishga ruxsat berish, giyohvandlikka olib keladigan sirpanchiq yo'l bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Osonlikcha yomon vaziyatga olib keladigan harakatlar ketma-ketligi.

cards.ex: You're asking for trouble if you leave your car unlocked in this neighborhood.
cards.exUz: Agar bu mahallada mashinangizni qulflamagan holda qoldirsangiz, muammo so'rayapsiz.
cards.uzDef: O'zini muammoga duchor qiladigan ish qilish, xavfli vaziyatni yaratish.

cards.ex: Skydiving without proper training is dicing with death.
cards.exUz: To'g'ri tayyorgarliksiz osmondan sakrash - o'lim bilan o'ynash.
cards.uzDef: O'lim xavfi bilan bog'liq bo'lgan xavfli harakatlarni amalga oshirish.

cards.ex: Investing in the stock market can be a high-stakes game.
cards.exUz: Fond bozoriga sarmoya kiritish yuksak xatar o'yini bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Katta yo'qotishlar yoki yutuqlar xavfi bilan bog'liq vaziyat.

cards.ex: The lightning struck too close for comfort during the storm.
cards.exUz: Bo'ron paytida chaqmoq noqulay darajada yaqin urdi.
cards.uzDef: Noqulay darajada yaqin bo'lgan xavfli vaziyat.

cards.ex: He enjoys living on the edge, always taking risks.
cards.exUz: U xavf ostida yashashni yoqtiradi, doimiy ravishda xavfga kiradi.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda xavfli yoki xavfli vaziyatlarda yashash.

cards.ex: The politician is walking a fine line trying to please both sides.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi ikki tomonni ham mamnun qilishga urinib, nozik chegarada yuribdi.
cards.uzDef: Hukm qilish qiyin bo'lgan vaziyatda ehtiyotkorlik bilan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: If you don't study, you run the risk of failing the exam.
cards.exUz: Agar o'qimasangiz, imtihondan yiqilish xavfiga duchor bo'lasiz.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki noxush narsa sodir bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan harakatni amalga oshirish.

cards.ex: If they continue arguing like that, their relationship is heading for disaster.
cards.exUz: Agar ular shunday bahslashishda davom etsalar, ularning munosabatlari falokatga yo'l olmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Falokatga olib keladigan yo'nalishda ketayotgan bo'lish.
